name: 78750 · Austin, TX
findings: ZIP 78750 (Austin) has 132 nonprofit organizations. 70 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 60 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 78750 (Austin) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
49% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 78750 (Austin) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).
